correctness.rationale: The token adjacency construction has 45 states and 120 edges; BFS computes every one of 45×45 distances. For each landmark, the 990 pair-distinction indicators give an exact resolving criterion. Independently exhausted all C(45,4)=148995 four-subsets (none resolving) and C(45,5)=1221759 five-subsets (exactly 189540 resolving). Full induced 120-element S5 action yielded orbit sizes 1534×120, 90×60, 1×30, 1×24, 1×6. Full distance>=3 clique enumeration yielded 30 five-packings, none larger, and orbits 6+24. This finite universe was truly exhausted, not statistically sampled.
residual_risks: Induced S5 orbit histogram is not a claim about a potentially larger full graph automorphism group; the theorem is on this single token graph.
